bullets.text: Containers Made Easy - **VS Code** integrates **Copilot** for seamless container management, enhancing developer productivity.
Smart Holiday Shopping - **Copilot** in **Edge** offers cashback and price tracking to simplify festive shopping.
Xbox Gaming Experience - **Windows 11** introduces a full screen gaming experience for handhelds and PCs.
Web Install API Testing - **Microsoft Edge** now supports the **Web Install API** for improved web app installations.
AI in Security Operations - **Microsoft Defender Experts** leverage AI for enhanced SOC efficiency and threat detection.
Notepad Gets New Features - **Notepad** update introduces table support and AI text features for Windows Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and Xbox full screen experience now available for **Windows Insiders**.
Gartner Recognition - **Microsoft** named a Leader in the **Gartner Magic Quadrant** for Access Management for the ninth year.
Holiday Buying Guide - Explore the best **Windows 11 PCs** and deals for the holiday season.
